title: Torch & Trowel Field Notes
description: Articles and teaching notes about screen-free drawing, scaffolded art instruction, and helping students build real drawing skill.

items.title: Why Blank Pages Freeze Beginning Artists
items.summary: A blank page looks simple to an experienced artist. To a beginner, it can feel like being asked to solve every drawing problem at once.
items.content_text: A blank page is not actually empty. For a beginning artist, it is full of invisible decisions. Guided drawing narrows the first few decisions so the student can begin, practice one visible skill at a time, and build toward independence.
